legend.old_baseline: existing value inherited from HF-03 code; not a verified sensor/mount measurement
legend.design_convention: algorithm/interface convention chosen now; not a physical acceptance threshold
legend.pending_measurement: numeric value must come from on-site measurement before it can be frozen/accepted

fitting_selection_thresholds.current_meaning: loose source +Z prior, tolerates ~60 deg tilt; NOT verified gravity
fitting_selection_thresholds.proposed: do not hard-set world Z; use an independently measured up-axis candidate plus a stated angular uncertainty; apply the constraint before support counting (PCL perpendicular-plane mechanism)
fitting_selection_thresholds.needs: mount pitch/tilt measurement or an independently confirmed level-floor reference; the observed stable ~25 deg offset must be explained (mount pitch vs truly tilted surface)

fitting_selection_thresholds.proposed: measure residual vs range on the actual sensor, then set per range band (near/mid/far); report residual percentiles, not a single truncated RMS
fitting_selection_thresholds.needs: point-plane residual statistics on a known flat surface at several ranges

fitting_selection_thresholds.proposed: spatially balanced sampling (radial/angular or voxel bins) so a dense near wall cannot fill the budget; sampling only selects fit points, original indices preserved for support re-check
keep as an absolute floor; add an ROI-relative support fraction instead of whole-scene fraction
evaluate against the confirmed ground ROI sample, not the whole scene (whole-scene floor support was only ~0.20 here, so a whole-scene 0.5 gate can never pass)
redefine on ROI/region ground support; keep separate from physical acceptance

fitting_selection_thresholds.source: core/ground.py (HF-03); review 3.5 notes support set is truncated at 0.05 m so a 0.12 m RMS gate is not discriminating
fitting_selection_thresholds.proposed: report full untruncated residuals on independent known ground regions plus high percentiles; do not treat 0.12 as a precision guarantee
size from N=log(1-p)/log(1-w^3) after ROI restriction; keep a bounded cap and a bounded candidate list (K)
split by capture frame group AND spatial region; no same-surface leakage between fit and validation

physical_acceptance_thresholds.proposed: confirmed by on-site visual/physical identification of the region and its extent, not by automatic ranking
confirm the floor is level/planar within the ROI; single-plane premise
across independent frame groups: bound the change in normal angle and offset d; support insufficient -> unknown/degraded
error against at least one scale-measured static reference; report measurement uncertainty; accept only after the threshold is frozen before measuring
compare fitted d to a rough on-site height statement as a consistency check, never as the source of the value

assumptions: independent uniform picks of 3 distinct points
w = probability a picked point lies on the target plane within the inlier threshold, measured on the restricted ROI sample
an organized rotating LiDAR gives spatially correlated returns, so the formula is an estimate/upper bound, not a guarantee
three sample points must be mutually distinct and non-collinear; degenerate samples are skipped
ransac_budget.observation: default 150 iterations only reaches p=0.99 when the in-ROI ground fraction w is >= ~0.30; the whole-scene ground fraction observed here is ~0.20, so ROI restriction (raising w) is required before 150 can be justified
ransac_budget.recommendation: target p=0.999 with w measured on the ROI sample; cap N (e.g. <=2000) and keep a bounded candidate list; never dead-set world Z when the up-axis is unknown
